Title: Azure Stream Analytics—MATCH_RECOGNIZE function is now available

Body.Content:
The MATCH_RECOGNIZE function is now available in Stream Analytics. This clause is used to search for a set of events over a data stream. It enables you to define event patterns using regular expressions and aggregate methods to verify and extract values from the match.

Learn more.
